description_en: Retrieves the list of ECS instances under the current user's VPC and vSwitch
description_zh: 获取当前用户vpc和vswitch下的ECS 实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-ecs-instances --page 1 --size 10 --ecs-instance-ids i-bp13y63575oypr9d0000_,_i-bp1gyhphjaj73jsr0000 --ecs-instance-name test --tags tagKey_:_a_,_tagValue_:_b --vpc-id vpc-bp16k1dvzxtmagcva0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEcsInstances

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results. Maximum value: 500
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的结果数。默认值10，最大值500
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The list of ECS instance IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID列表。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: ecs_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ECS instance tags. The following fields must be included:

tagKey: the tag key.
tagValue: the tag value
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例标签，必须包含：

tagKey：标签键
tagValue：标签值
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the ECS instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

X-Total-Count.description_en: The total number of returned records

cloudAssistantStatus.description_en:
The Cloud Assistant installation status. Valid values:

true: Installed.
false: Not installed
cloudAssistantStatus.description_zh:
云助手安装状态，支持：

true：已安装
false：未安装

collectors.description_en: The list of collectors deployed on the ECS instance
collectors.description_zh: 该ECS实例上，采集器信息列表

configs.description_en: The configuration file information of the collector
configs.description_zh: 采集器的配置文件信息

content.example:
- key: log
 title: Log file content
 description: >
 Contains log file lines.
 ....

dryRun.description_en:
Indicates whether to only validate without creating the collector. Valid values:

true: Only validates without creating.
false: Validates and creates
dryRun.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器。支持：

true：只校验不创建
false：校验并创建

configType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

collectorTargetInstance: the collector Output.
collectorDeployMachine: the deployment machine of the collector.
collectorElasticsearchForKibana: the Elasticsearch instance information that supports Kibana dashboards
configType.description_zh:
配置类型。支持：

collectorTargetInstance：采集器Output
collectorDeployMachine：采集器的部署机器
collectorElasticsearchForKibana：支持Kibana仪表盘的Elasticsearch实例信息

enableMonitoring.description_en:
Indicates whether Monitoring is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance and instanceType is set to elasticsearch. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
enableMonitoring.description_zh:
是否启用Monitoring，当configType为collectorTargetInstance，且instanceType为elasticsearch时显示。支持：

true：启用
false：不启用

groupId.description_en: The machine group ID. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine

items.description_en: The list of access addresses of the instance specified in the collector Output. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
items.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

instanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance associated with the collector. When configType is set to collectorTargetInstance, this is the instance ID of the collector Output. When configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ACKCluster, this is the ACK (Container Kubernetes) cluster ID
instanceId.description_zh: 采集器关联的实例ID。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时，为采集器Output的实例ID；当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时，为ACK（容器Kubernetes）集群ID

instanceType.description_en: The instance type specified in the collector Output. Valid values: elasticsearch and logstash. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
instanceType.description_zh: 采集器Output指定的实例类型。支持elasticsearch、logstash。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

machines.description_en: The list of ECS machines on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ECSInstanceId
machines.description_zh: 采集器所部署的ECS机器列表信息。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ECSInstanceId时显示

agentStatus.description_en:
The status of each collector on the ECS instance. Valid values:

heartOk: normal heartbeat.
heartLost: abnormal heartbeat.
uninstalled: not installed.
failed: installation failed
agentStatus.description_zh:
ECS上各采集器的状态。支持：

heartOk：心跳正常
heartLost：心跳异常
uninstalled：未安装
failed：安装失败

instanceId.description_en: The list of ECS machine IDs

protocol.description_en: The transport protocol, which must be consistent with the access protocol of the instance specified in the collector Output. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
protocol.description_zh: 传输协议，需要与采集器Output指定实例的访问协议保持一致。支持HTTP、HTTPS。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

type.description_en:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine. Valid values:

ECSInstanceId: ECS.
ACKCluster: Container Kubernetes
type.description_zh:
采集器部署的机器类型，当configType为collectorDeployMachine时显示。支持：

ECSInstanceId：ECS
ACKCluster：容器Kubernetes

userName.description_en: The username used to access the instance specified in the collector Output. Default value: elastic. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance or collectorElasticsearchForKibana
userName.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问用户名，默认为elastic。当configType为collectorTargetInstance或collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

gmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the collector was created

gmtUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the collector was last updated

resType.description_en: The collector type. Valid values: fileBeat, metricBeat, heartBeat, and auditBeat

resVersion.description_en: The collector version. When the deployment machine type is ECS, only 6.8.5_with_community is supported
resVersion.description_zh: 采集器版本。采集器部署的机器类型为ECS时，只支持6.8.5_with_community

status.description_en:
The collector status. Valid values:

activing: taking effect.
active: active
status.description_zh:
采集器状态。支持：

activing：生效中
active：已生效

vpcId.description_en: The VPC ID of the collector
vpcId.description_zh: 采集器所在的专有网络ID

ipAddress.description_en: The IP address information of the ECS instance

ipType.description_en:
The IP address type. Valid values:

public: public IP address.
private: private network address
ipType.description_zh:
IP地址类型。支持：

public：公网地址
private：私网地址

osType.description_en:
The operating system type of the ECS instance. Valid values:

windows: Windows operating system.
linux: Linux operating system
osType.description_zh:
ECS实例的操作系统类型。支持：

windows：Windows操作系统
linux：Linux操作系统

status.description_en:
The status of the ECS instance. Valid values:

running: running.
starting: starting.
stopping: stopping.
stopped: stopped
status.description_zh:
ECS实例的状态。支持：

running：运行中
starting：启动中
stopping：停止中
stopped：已停止

tags.description_en: The tag information of the ECS instance
